Game Overview

Cuckoo vs Crow Monster puts players into a adventure experience centered on navigate treacherous terrains as a daring Cuckoo on a quest to reclaim stolen eggs from the menacing Crow Monsters. With simple controls and progressively challenging levels, perfect your double jumps to overcome obstacles and seize victory. Each thrilling stage heightens the adventure in this vibrant 2D platformer.
